01 / Meet Diraa

Made for your kind of everyday.

Diraa sees personal style as a mood, a feeling and a way to show who you are.

Contemporary forms meet the charm of handcrafted beads in pieces designed to add colour, character and a playful point of view. Easy enough for everyday moments, expressive enough to make the outfit yours.
